subject: Borealis vendor onboarding — SLA & support contact matrix
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Liao <anna.liao@borealis-systems.com>, procurement@borealis-systems.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Borealis vendor onboarding — initial SLA & support contact request

Hi Anna / Borealis procurement team,

Thanks for moving us to the onboarding stage — excited to get this live. Procurement asked for a short SLA/support checklist so they can complete the vendor setup and issue the PO. Could you please confirm the items below so we can open the PO and book Dedicated capacity?

Requested items:
- Primary + secondary support contacts (name, title, email, phone)
- Escalation path with 24/7 on-call for Sev 1 (names/roles and expected response times)
- Uptime target and measurement window (99.x% monthly? rolling 30d?)
- Scheduled maintenance windows and advance notice policy
- Incident reporting & post-incident report (RCA) SLA (time to deliver)
- Billing/PO instructions and invoicing cadence (net30/net45, remit address, required PO fields)

If you have a standard SLA pack or procurement checklist you can attach, that'll speed things up. We also need any SOC2/attestation links if available for procurement review.

Goal: get vendor set up in our procurement system and issue initial PO by Oct 8. Are you able to provide the above by end of day Monday Oct 4?

Thanks — I'll follow up with our procurement tracker (PROC-455) once we have the doc.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Diego Fernandez | Redwood Inference

From: Anna Liao <anna.liao@borealis-systems.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@borealis-systems.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@borealis-systems.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Borealis vendor onboarding — initial SLA & support contact request

Diego —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching our standard SLA and our PO instructions (see attachments). Summary below to expedite procurement:

Support contacts:
- Primary: Mike Chen, Technical Account Lead — mike.chen@borealis-systems.com / +1 (415) 555-0190
- Secondary: Priya Natarajan, Support Manager — priya.natarajan@borealis-systems.com / +1 (415) 555-0191

Escalation path (Sev definitions attached in SLA):
- Sev 1 (service down, critical impact): 15 min ack by on-call, 1 hour initial mitigation window, 4 hour operational workaround target; escalates to Mike Chen (TAL) then VP of Ops if unresolved after 6 hours.
- Sev 2 (degraded, partial impact): 1 hour ack, 24 hour resolution target depending on scope.

Uptime/measurement:
- Target: 99.95% monthly availability measured as calendar-month uptime for customer-facing inference endpoints.
- Measurement window: rolling 30-day and calendar-month reporting. Credit calculations per attached SLA (section 3).

Maintenance windows:
- Weekly maintenance allowed Sun 02:00–04:00 PT; emergency maintenance will be communicated with minimum 24 hours notice when possible.

Incident reporting:
- Sev 1 initial incident post within 2 hours; full RCA within 7 business days for major incidents.

Billing/PO:
- Preferred: PO to: Borealis Systems; remit to: accounts@borealis-systems.com; net30 by default. Please include Redwood account id and contract reference on invoices.

Attachments: Borealis-SLA-v1.pdf (pdf), Borealis-PO-Instructions.docx (docx)

DocuSign: we'll send a DocuSign link for the vendor agreement after procurement confirms PO details.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the SLA.

Best,
Anna Liao
Head of Strategic Procurement | Borealis Systems

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Borealis vendor onboarding — initial SLA & support contact matrix

Thanks Anna — this is great and very helpful. A few clarifying items from procurement and our legal/compliance folks so we can finalize the PO:

1) Uptime measurement: procurement wants to confirm that the credit calculation uses calendar-month availability (not only rolling 30-day) — noted your SLA mentions both; can you confirm calendar-month is the primary measurement for credits?
2) RCA timing: our security team prefers an RCA within 5 business days for Sev 1 if possible; would Borealis be open to that for Redwood's paid tiers?
3) Invoice remittance: could you confirm the remit address and whether you accept electronic invoicing (EDI) or only emailed PDFs?

Internally, can Lauren/Monica/Karthik weigh in on whether the uptime target of 99.95% is acceptable for Dedicated compute, and whether the proposed Sev 1 ack/mitigation times meet our SLOs?

If procurement confirms calendar-month as the primary measure and we get the RCA timing tightened to 5 business days, we'll proceed to open a PO and expect DocuSign shortly after.

Diego
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

> - We should request SOC2 Type II report link before PO closes — Monica, can you pull that from your compliance pack?

Diego / team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Confirmations below: 
- Calendar-month availability will be the primary metric for credit calculation; rolling 30-day will be used for internal monitoring.
- We can commit to a 5 business-day RCA for Sev 1 incidents for contracted customers.
- Remit: accounts@borealis-systems.com; we accept emailed PDF invoices and EDI. Please include Redwood account id and PO number on the invoice.
- SOC2 Type II: link provided in the attachment footer and we can provide a redacted report to procurement under NDA if needed.

I've also sent the DocuSign package to the procurement email; link below. Once PO is raised with the remit and account details, we can complete signature and schedule a brief onboarding call to test on-call notifications.
